backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing services, queue management, feedback, and user profiles with access control and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping product features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens, themes, and global background/foreground properties for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routing, authentication gating, profile setup, theming, and global UI providers.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown to non-admin users attempting to access admin-only routes, with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication wrapper that blocks access until Internet Identity is initialized and the user is logged in.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with query cache clearing and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting new users to enter and save their name before accessing the app.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header navigation, mobile menu, and footer, highlighting active routes and rendering page content.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminPage.ts: Provides the admin dashboard with service selection, queue management actions, and feedback viewing, gated by admin access checks.
frontend/src/features/feedback/FeedbackP: Implements a feedback form allowing users to select a service, rate it, and submit comments with validation and success alerts.
frontend/src/features/queue/QueuePage.ts: Lets users select a service, join or leave its queue, and monitor their real‑time queue position with refresh and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, logout, identity persistence, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping actor calls for user profiles, services, queue operations, and admin actions with caching and polling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables, theming, and dark mode overrides using OKLCH values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page UI featuring hero banner, feature cards, and “how it works” steps linking to queue and feedback sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, supporting hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings using CSS variables.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, requirements, features, and pending feature requests for the Smart Queue system.
